basic_details.job_title: DLSA Bijnor Peon Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Bijnor Peon Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/bijnor.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Bijnor Chaprasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DLSA Bijnor Chaprasi Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Chaprasi post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Chaprasi post, candidates must be retired employees from a Civil Court, Collectorate, or Court. This is the primary qualification required for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Chaprasi position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chaprasi position is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification, but candidates must be retired employees.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Chaprasi post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Chaprasi post will receive a salary of Rs. 7000 per month. This is a fixed monthly remuneration for the contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DLSA Bijnor Chaprasi Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Chaprasi post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Chaprasi post in the District Legal Services Authority Bijnor recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Chaprasi recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Chaprasi recruitment will involve Document Verification and an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Chaprasi post is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Legal Services Authority Bijnor, which is https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/bijnor.
